title: arashouse deploy-code --json
description: What `arashouse deploy-code --json` prints: the leased slot and one entry per source deployed, in order. It holds no file contents and no secret.

code.description: Deploys stop at the first that fails; the command then exits 10 (or 7 when a guard refused it), with the lease still held.

source.description: The folder or zip as the caller named it.

subpath.description: Where it landed in the slot's tree, `/`-separated; "" is the top of the tree.

ok.description: The files are in place and the slot came back up.

deleted.description: Files the deploy.json delete list removed.

detail.description: One line: what the host did, with its times, or why it failed.
